scenes.title: Sela's passage and warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver, only by day, and offers a first-light departure tomorrow. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago on the night the bell first rang, with warm water according to her grandmother.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the flooded mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and hymn-book pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement; the search yields nothing else, and bad air injures Oren.

scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.title: The midnight bell and submerged congregation
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn that the Kelp Mother takes children. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, louder humming returns, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive and a long rest
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out tomorrow at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and a second lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
